primaryContact.whyRelevant: Verified current chapter president and accountable face of the board; the most practical first contact for a venue/catering conversation. The board page also identifies the VP Programs function as responsible for scheduled chapter-meeting programs, but no individual is named for that role.

recommended_next_step.title: Recommended next step
recommended_next_step.body: Email Matt Lowy at president@pmimontcomdchapter.org with a short local-venue alternative: Bethesda Marriott can host a 6:30–9:00 p.m. chapter dinner in a smaller meeting room or private-dining setup with buffet/dinner service, presentation support, and Zoom simulcast; ask who owns venue contracting (Matt, the VP Programs function, or another planner), whether That’s Amore is contracted for 2027, typical attendance/food-and-beverage minimum, AV requirements, and whether one pilot dinner or the annual member-appreciation dinner is open to bids. Do not pitch a room block unless they identify an overnight need. Follow up once after five business days; if there is no response, route a light-touch account-development note through the chapter’s public contact channel.

salespersonPacket.whoRole: President, PMI Montgomery County MD Chapter
salespersonPacket.why: Strong catering/day-meeting fit: Bethesda Marriott’s official event page lists 27 event rooms, 18,719 square feet of event space, a 450-person largest-space capacity, smaller rooms including Pooks Hill and Bethesda with banquet capacity, private dining at Cooper’s Mill, and in-house dinner catering. The hotel is at 5151 Pooks Hill Road in Bethesda. This supports a direct alternative proposal for a recurring dinner with presentation/AV and Zoom capability, but it does not establish that PMI-MC needs a hotel venue or that the hotel can displace That’s Amore. Guestrooms should be positioned as optional, not assumed.
salespersonPacket.when: Monthly dinner pattern is documented on Wednesday evenings, generally 6:30–9:00 p.m.; recent 2026 examples are May 6, September 2, October 7, and November 4. FedTALKS is November 17, 2026, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., at the Waldorf Astoria. As of November 12, 2026, the November 4 dinner has passed and FedTALKS is upcoming.

Do not pitch a room block unless they identify an overnight need. Follow up once after five business days; if there is no response, route a light-touch account-development note through the chapter’s public contact channel.
uncertainties: Who is the current named planner or contracting owner for monthly dinners: Matt Lowy, a VP Programs volunteer, or another chapter officer?
Is That’s Amore contracted or merely the current recurring venue, and is the chapter reviewing venues for 2027?
What is the typical in-person attendance and required food-and-beverage minimum?
Does the chapter require house AV, microphones, screens, recording, or a specific Zoom setup?
Are any speakers, board members, or attendees expected to need guestrooms?
Is the November 17 FedTALKS listing only an attendee/education opportunity, or does PMI-MC have any role in programming, sponsorship, or room sourcing?
